in_hebrew.name: Aubyn
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aubyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Aubyn is derived from the Old French word 'Albain', which means 'elf, friend' or 'love'. In English literature, Aubyn is the name of a character in the novel 'Aubyn and Helena' by Elizabeth Cleghorn Gaskell. The name is also found in the middle ages, particularly in the Celtic region.
